project.problemStatement: Create an owned submission from multiple configuration sections and an uploaded source file.

invariants: a configuration references only owned available resources

capabilities.name: Create submission
capabilities.purpose: Produce an owned submission and its generated items from the configured sections and uploaded source.

userInput.summary: Operator supplies a title, category, result quantity, and the uploaded source resource references.

systemBehavior.summary: Validate the configuration, persist it atomically as the submission aggregate, and enqueue generation of the requested number of items.

output.summary: A submission identifier, terminal status, and the generated item list with media URLs.

failures.summary: Unauthorized, invalid configuration, or lifecycle conflict are surfaced as typed errors without partial persistence.

downstreamUse.summary: Submissions feed the result presentation and the operator history.

capabilities.name: Upload source file
capabilities.purpose: Provide a validated, owned source resource consumed by submission creation.

systemBehavior.summary: Validate the file and persist it as an owned resource with a checksum.

output.summary: An owned resource identifier, its checksum, and availability status.

failures.summary: Rejected or unauthorized uploads return typed errors and persist nothing.

downstreamUse.summary: The resource reference is consumed by submission creation through a runtime data dependency.

capabilities.name: Suggest title
capabilities.purpose: Generate a title suggestion from the source and write it back into the title field so the operator can accept or edit it.

userInput.summary: Operator triggers title assistance after uploading a source; the uploaded resource reference is the input.

systemBehavior.summary: Invoke an external text-generation capability over the source and return a single title suggestion.

output.summary: A generated title suggestion string with a terminal status.

failures.summary: Provider timeout or unavailability leaves the title field unchanged and surfaces a typed error.

downstreamUse.summary: The suggested title populates the submission title field consumed by submission creation.

acceptanceCriteria: Triggering title assistance returns a non-empty suggestion string of the title type.

capabilities.name: External submission review
capabilities.purpose: Route a submission to external human review once the review orchestration is decided.

userInput.summary: Operator would submit a finished submission for external review.

systemBehavior.summary: Would forward the submission to an external review process; the orchestration is undecided.

output.summary: Would return an external review reference once the process is defined.

failures.summary: Undefined until the external review contract is decided.

downstreamUse.summary: Would track external review status; consumers are undecided.
